_comment: The site chrome, in every language the atlas publishes. These strings
describe the page furniture, not any country: 'Filter plates by theme'
is the same sentence whether the plates are French or Korean, so it is
written once here instead of five times.
Country copy — the masthead line, the dek, the colophon, the reading
notes — lives in countries/<slug>/ui.json, because it is about that
{n} is filled with the number of plates the country publishes, so a
nine-plate country does not advertise eleven.
